1) Scope clarity: the SOW lists "device posture policy review" but doesn't explicitly call out the list of signals we need prioritized (MDM telemetry, MDM vendor support matrix, conditional access for unmanaged devices). Can you amend to include a short appendix that maps required device signals to Okta product capabilities?

2) Security evidence: Vivek will need SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary, and an export of audit-log retention policy tied to time ranges. I attached a checklist (security-evidence-request.xlsx) that maps what we need for our procurement checklist.

3) Procurement path & timing: we prefer a split signature flow — SOW for services signed now, license uplift on a 30-day delayed signature pending finance approval. Please confirm if DocuSign supports that workflow for you.

4) Cost: the PS number looks reasonable but can you confirm travel is out-of-scope (we'll prefer remote-first)?

If Okta and ZeroTrust are aligned on the scope appendix and you can provide the evidence items, I can shepherd the SOW through our procurement and get a PO raised next week. Suggest a 30-minute alignment call Thursday 10–10:30 PT.

Thanks,
